fat_pct.quote: | **fat %** | **20.40%** average | % – presumed fresh cheese | 12 on-farm manufactured “Valencay”, soft goat’s milk cheese, analyzed within 5 weeks after manufacture, ripened for 5 weeks. Average values for protein 15.71%, fat 20.40%, carbohydrate 1.79% and ash 2.02%, ripening rate water-soluble N / total N 59.13%. Also described as: Samples from 12 cheeses ripened for 5 weeks were analyzed within 5 weeks after manufacture | https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/chikusan/66/5/66_422/_article – DOI: 10.2508/chikusan.66.422 – Nishiyama et al., Nihon Chikusan Gakkaiho 66:422-429, 1995. Abstract via https://eurekamag.com/research/002/980/002980242.php |

ammonia.reason: Low urease/deaminase ammonia in 11-day to 5-week lactic goat; WSN/TN ~59% but no washed-rind deamination.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol, indole and 4-ethylphenol from pasture and goat-skin flora plus raw-milk enterococci.

bitter.reason: Low hydrophobic peptide accumulation from chymosin + Lactococcus proteinases in acid curd.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation; only trace methyl ketones from surface Penicillium/Geotrichum.

browning.reason: Residual lactose ~1.8% but low pH and acid curd limit Maillard; rind ash is charcoal not browning.

buttery.reason: Modest diacetyl/acetoin from Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis citrate metabolism.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic-pentanoic-hexanoic acids from raw-milk lipase and Geotrichum lipolysis of goat fat.

creaminess.reason: Thin proteolyzed creamy layer under Geotrichum rind with high moisture lactic paste.

crumbliness.reason: Demineralized acid casein network at pH ~4.6 gives chalky friable center when young.

firmness.reason: Lactic coagulated, drained truncated pyramid retains shape; not pressed or cooked.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylethanol/phenylacetaldehyde and pasture terpenes; goat milk lactones.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from Geotrichum candidum esterase esterification of free fatty acids.

goaty.reason: 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic plus octanoic/decanoic acids characteristic of goat triglycerides released by lipolysis.

malty_nutty.reason: Low Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal and pyrazines; brief aging limits hazelnut notes.

melt.reason: Acid-demineralized low-pH curd does not flow; casein does not fuse on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from Geotrichum/Mucor lipoxygenase on linoleic acid plus ashed rind.

oil_off.reason: Low total fat ~20.4% and acid matrix entrap fat; no free oil on heating.

smoky.reason: Vegetable charcoal ash coating is inert carbon, no wood-smoke guaiacol/syringol.

sour_vinegar.reason: High L-lactic acid from mesophilic lactic fermentation with trace acetic acid in lactic curd.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata kneading; acid curd fractures rather than aligns.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Raw milk, uncooked curd; minimal heat-induced methional/dimethyl sulfide.

sweet.reason: Lactose fermented to ~1.8% carbohydrate; little residual lactose or sweet amino acids.

umami.reason: Moderate glutamate from early Geotrichum aminopeptidase proteolysis.
